predictions.rationale: Central graph model representing elements and relationships in Activity Diagrams; core to implementing the feature’s behavior.
Primary class for the Activity Diagram itself (inherits from UMLDiagram). Manages nodes/edges and user-visible diagram operations.
Responsible for painting Activity Diagram elements; directly supports visual representation of the feature.
Handles automatic layout of Activity Diagram nodes/edges, refining the diagram’s appearance during editing.
Initialisation class that registers the Activity Diagram with the application; critical for enabling the feature at startup.
Factory that provides property panels specific to Activity Diagrams, supporting user interaction and editing.
Concrete property panel class for Activity Diagrams; offers UI for viewing/editing diagram properties.
UI action that creates or opens an Activity Diagram; directly tied to user interaction for this feature.
Part of the model subsystem defining Activity Diagram meta-model elements; foundational support for the feature.
Factory for creating Activity Diagram instances in the newer 'activity2' diagram module; supports alternative implementation.
